title: From Lab to Reality: A Practical Evaluation of Deep Learning Models and LLMs for Vulnerability Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating classification metrics (precision, recall, F1-score) and prediction distributions on highly imbalanced vulnerability datasets to identify models' tendencies to output all-negative or all-positive predictions, disproportionately favoring the majority (non-vulnerable) class.

Conducting cross-dataset evaluation to determine if models memorize dataset-specific correlations and labeling artifacts (noisy labels) rather than learning generalizable semantics for vulnerability detection.
